jobs.description:
**T&T House of Champions | Oakland, CA**

**Residential Care & Operations Coordinator**

**Pay:** $26.00–$28.00 per hour (reviews after 90 days)  
**Schedule:** Part-Time (20+ hours per week)  
**Work Location:** In Person

**Scheduling & Shift Requirements**

**Note:** This position does not have a fixed or permanently assigned schedule. Weekly shifts will fluctuate based on staffing coverage, resident needs, and overall program operations.

Employees **must** be flexible and available to work across the following potential 8hr shifts:

* **Day:** 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM
* **Evening:** 4:00 PM – 12:00 AM
* **Overnight:** 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM

A minimum of 20 hours per week is guaranteed, with opportunities for additional hours based on program and staffing needs. Shift assignments may vary weekly, and a consistent schedule or shift cannot be guaranteed.

**About T&T House of Champions**

T&T House of Champions is a Short-Term Residential Therapeutic Program (STRTP) in Oakland, California, serving male youth clients ages 12–17 who require intensive out-of-home placement and therapeutic support.

Our mission is to provide a safe, structured, and supportive environment where youth can develop life skills, address mental health challenges, strengthen social relationships, and prepare for successful transitions to family-based care or independent living.

**Position Summary**

T&T House of Champions is seeking a dependable, proactive, and experienced Residential Care & Operations Coordinator to support the daily care, supervision, and operational needs of our residential clients.

This hands-on position combines direct client care with facility operations and administrative support. The individual will work under the direction of organizational leadership to help maintain a safe, structured, therapeutic, and well-managed residential environment.

The ideal candidate is adaptable, organized, accountable, and comfortable balancing the needs of clients and daily facility operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Direct Resident Care & Supervision**

* Provide direct supervision, guidance, and support to youth clients
* Promote a safe, structured, and therapeutic living environment
* Assist youth with daily living skills, personal development, and positive decision-making
* Support emotional regulation, social development, and independent living skills
* Respond appropriately to behavioral concerns and crisis situations in accordance with program protocols

**Facility Operations & Coordination**

* Support daily facility operations and help maintain a clean, safe, and organized environment
* Assist with daily routines, household activities, supplies, inventory, and facility needs
* Provide day-to-day guidance and support to direct care staff, as assigned
* Assist with shift coordination, staff communication, and smooth transitions between shifts
* Identify and communicate operational, maintenance, and safety concerns to organizational leadership

**Documentation & Program Support**

* Maintain accurate resident progress notes, daily logs, incident reports, and required documentation
* Communicate resident observations, concerns, and progress to the treatment team
* Follow established medication procedures within applicable training and authorization requirements
* Support organizational compliance with agency policies and applicable California STRTP licensing requirements
* Develop and facilitate recreational, educational, social, and life-skills activities
* Accompany youth to appointments and community resources as assigned
* Participate in mandatory meetings, trainings, and ongoing professional development

**Minimum Qualifications & Requirements**

Candidates must meet at least one of the education and experience pathways, subject to applicable STRTP requirements:

* Must successfully complete required federal and state fingerprint-based criminal background clearances, including applicable FBI and California Department of Justice (DOJ) fingerprint checks, and meet all applicable STRTP clearance requirements
* Must be at least 21 years of age
* Must possess a valid California driver's license and maintain a driving record that meets organizational insurance and driving requirements
* Bachelor's degree or valid Child Development Teaching Permit
* At least 12 semester units in a relevant field plus 100 hours of youth experience
* Qualifying Alcohol/Drug Counselor certificate or vocational credential, with required youth experience
* At least one year of experience working or volunteering in a licensed group home or STRTP
* Other CDSS-approved education and experience combinations, where applicable

**Additional Requirements:**

* Must be willing and able to transport youth to appointments, activities, community resources, and other destinations as assigned
* Must be available to drive for other organizational business and operational needs as necessary
* Knowledge of community resources and support services
* Strong written and verbal communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team
* Ability to maintain professional boundaries, confidentiality, and sound judgment
* Flexibility to work day, evening, and overnight shifts based on program needs
* Must attend mandatory monthly trainings for ongoing education and professional development

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working with adolescents, at-risk youth, or individuals with behavioral or mental health needs
* Experience in a group home, STRTP, residential treatment, or behavioral health setting
* Previous leadership, staff coordination, or facility operations experience
* Knowledge of trauma-informed care, crisis intervention, and de-escalation techniques

Pay: $26.00 - $29.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 20.0 per week

**Who We Are:**

Nightingale Veterinary Partners is a fast-growing family of veterinary practices, headquartered in New York City. The organization includes veterinary practices in New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Philadelphia, Massachusetts and Florida. We are building a company focused on clinical excellence, sustainable growth, and long-term value creation.

  

**About the Role:**

Nightingale Veterinary Partners is seeking a Project Coordinator to join our growing Practice Launch Department. This role is integral to ensuring the successful opening of our new veterinary facilities, focusing on on-site coordination, vendor management, and overseeing facility setup. The Project Coordinator plays a hands-on role in creating seamless transitions from setup to operational excellence, contributing to our mission of transforming veterinary care.

  

**What You'd Do:**

* On-Site Coordination:
  + Arrive on-site 2–4 weeks before the anticipated launch to coordinate and oversee pre-launch activities.
  + Act as the primary on-site point of contact. Troubleshoot issues, manage vendors, and ensure smooth execution of the facility setup process.
  + Remain on-site for 2–4 weeks post-transition to support the handover process and address any operational or setup concerns.
* Vendor and Stakeholder Management:
  + Liaise with vendors to ensure timely delivery and setup of equipment and supplies.
  + Work closely with operations, clinical teams, and external partners to ensure launch readiness.
* Site Assessments and Competitive Analysis:
  + Participate in site assessments for future projects, identifying challenges and opportunities.
  + Conduct competitive analysis to inform strategic decisions for upcoming locations.
  + Help establish market capacity by looking into costs and wait times.
* Cross-Departmental Collaboration:
  + In periods of launch inactivity, support clinical initiatives as a shared resource for the operations team.
  

**What We Require:**

* Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a related field.
* Proven experience in project coordination or site management, preferably in a healthcare or veterinary setting.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and stakeholders effectively.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot and adapt in ever evolving and dynamic environments.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to foster collaboration across teams and vendors.
* Willingness to travel extensively (30%) and be on-site for extended periods.
* Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform light physical tasks (e.g., assembling furniture).
* The ability to establish professional and decisive relationships with outside vendors while remaining diplomatic.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Background in veterinary medicine, healthcare, or facilities management.
* Familiarity with vendor negotiation and facility setup processes.

  

**What We Offer:**

* The salary range for this role is: $85,000 - 95,000. This salary range represents our target hiring range for this role. The proposed salary will be dependent on the candidate's skills, experience, and competencies

Academic Program Coordinator (Mentoring & Transitions)

**POSITION DETAILS**

**”At Baruch College we believe that student success is everyone’s responsibility"**

The Mentoring & Transition Programs Coordinator plays a central role in supporting the day-to-day operations and effectiveness of New Student Programs (NSP) by coordinating and co-supporting a large team of student employees who deliver peer mentoring, orientation, and transition programming for new students.

Reporting to NSP leadership, the coordinator provides centralized operational, administrative, and developmental support that enables peer mentors and orientation leaders to function effectively at scale. This role works closely with professional staff and student leaders to ensure consistent mentoring practices, smooth program execution, and a positive student employee experience.

Key responsibilities include:

* Coordinate and support the recruitment, onboarding, scheduling, and ongoing administration of peer mentors, orientation leaders, Federal Work Study students, and front desk staff.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for student employees, providing guidance, clarification, and support related to scheduling, expectations, and program operations.
* Support the supervision and development of student leaders by helping to identify strengths, emerging leadership capacity, and areas where additional coaching or support may be needed, in collaboration with NSP professional staff and senior student leaders.
* Assist in fostering a cohesive, well-trained peer mentor community by supporting training logistics, professional development activities, and communication efforts.
* Monitor and help assess the effectiveness of mentoring and orientation practices.
* Provide operational and logistical support for major NSP initiatives, including orientation, convocation, welcome programs, trainings, and workshops, including coordination of room reservations, facilities requests, and event setup.
* Serve as the unit’s primary liaison for operational systems and workflows, including work orders, procurement and requisitions, room scheduling, and shared digital records.
* Maintain accurate records related to student staffing, payroll, timesheets, onboarding documentation, and program operations using Microsoft 365 tools, SharePoint, and related systems.
* Support front desk operations and daily office functioning, helping to ensure a welcoming, responsive environment for students, staff, and campus partners.

jobs.description:
**COMMUNITY COORDINATOR**
=========================

* NYC HOUSING AUTHORITY

Posted on

11/12/2026

* Full-time

Location

BROOKLYN

* No exam required

Department

Brooklyn Property Management

Salary range: $62,868.00 – $89,303.00

Save

**Job Description**
-------------------

The New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA), the largest public housing authority in North America, was created in 1935 to provide decent, affordable housing for low- and moderate-income New Yorkers. NYCHA is home to 1 in 17 New Yorkers, providing affordable housing to 528,105 authorized residents through public housing and Permanent Affordability Commitment Together (PACT) programs as well as Section 8 housing. NYCHA has 177,569 apartments in 2,411 buildings across 335 conventional public housing and PACT developments. NYCHA’s mission is to provide quality housing for New Yorkers that is sustainable, inclusive, and safe, while fostering opportunities for economic mobility. Since the 2019 Agreement between NYCHA, the Department of Housing & Urban Development (HUD), and the U.S. District Court, Southern District of New York (SDNY), NYCHA has been working under a Federal Monitor structure. The HUD Agreement sets the
  
requirement to create a new Organizational Plan in collaboration with the Federal Monitor and sets forth various compliance related targets for NYCHA across major operational areas including Lead, Mold, Heat, Elevators, Pest, Waste Management, and Inspections.
  
  
NYCHA seeks a dynamic and service-oriented Neighborhood Service Coordinator with a passion for service. The Neighborhood Service Coordinator will work within a Neighborhood Model which organizes NYCHA’s housing portfolio around the City’s neighborhoods to allow staff to address the unique needs and challenges of their respective neighborhoods and housing developments. The vision is that staff will become stewards of their neighborhood housing portfolios, immersing themselves in the daily rhythms of their residents to fully understand their wants, needs, and challenges.
  
  
Reporting to a Borough Manager and Borough Vice President within Operations, responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:
  
  
1. Oversee engagement, activities, and support services in a geographic neighborhood with responsibility for 3-6 NYCHA developments. Key activities may include door-knocking, floor
  
and lobby meetings, one-on-one meetings with residents, phone-banking, surveys, community-based events, and other community meetings.
  
2. Conduct outreach to residents during operational projects, such as gas restoration and abatements, as well as emergency conditions such as high heat, frigid temperatures, or service
  
outages.
  
3. Conduct outreach to residents regarding issues of tenancy administration, such as rent payment, lease requirements and house rules, and annual recertification, and major policy initiatives or changes.
  
4. Ensure residents are aware of internal and external resources such as social services, employment and training opportunities; refer residents to other NYCHA departments when relevant.
  
5. Serve as a liaison between residents and NYCHA departments, both across all parts of Operations, as well as Asset & Capital Management.
  
6. Meet regularly with Resident Associations to understand concerns, support with accessing resources, assist with Tenant Participation Activity (TPA)-related matters.
  
7. Work closely with Resident Associations to identify desired services and coordinate to bring related resources to the development.
  
8. Develop and foster relationships with stakeholders to ensure successful engagement in NYCHA real estate preservation and development processes (RAD/PACT, NYC Housing Preservation Trust), including pre-conversion and for six months post-construction for converted properties. Host meetings to thoroughly explain the conversion process and help residents understand the Section 8 leasing process, as well as all aspects of project delivery.
  
9. Assess in collaboration with maintenance and trade staff the state of on-the-ground community assets and facilities such as Community Centers and Senior Centers.
  
10. Recruit residents to join programs; share flyers, establish information sessions, assist with applications. Promote NYCHA initiatives and campaigns such as recycling, sustainability, and
  
free internet.
  
11. Support and attend onsite events such as Family Days, resource fairs, and job fairs.
  
12. Coordinate with the Election team to support outreach efforts as needed and ensure successful coordination post-election.
  
13. Follow all guidance, policy & procedures regarding standards for resident outreach as issued by the Resident Engagement Department.
  
14. Maintain both quantitative and qualitative data documenting outreach efforts; resident feedback through canvassing, surveys, focus groups, and other methods; meeting attendance;
  
and other key metrics. Maintain records necessary to document any HUD-mandated resident consultation processes as appropriate.
  
15. Ability to work evening/weekends as needed and ability to travel between NYCHA properties within a neighborhood is required.
  
  
Additional Information:
  
1. For NYCHA employees: employees applying for transfer, promotional, title or level change opportunities must have served a period of one year at current location and in current title and level (if applicable).
  
2. NYCHA residents are encouraged to apply.
  
  
NYCHA provides benefits that include a choice of medical coverage plans, deferred compensation plans and a defined pension benefit plan as a member of the New York City Employees

**PURPOSE:**  
The Outreach Coordinator is the first point of contact for 9/11 responders, survivors, and their families seeking help with the September 11th Victim Compensation Fund (VCF). You will speak with prospective clients about their 9/11 exposure, illnesses, and proof of presence; determine whether they are eligible; and guide eligible clients through sign-up.  
  
**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Conduct intake conversations to assess each lead’s 9/11 exposure, medical conditions, and eligibility for the VCF.
* Sign up eligible leads as clients whenever possible
* Inform clients about the claims process to set expectations regarding the timeline and required documentation
* Monitor and manage your pipeline of new and existing leads through your Salesforce dashboard, prioritizing the most promising opportunities
* Keep Salesforce records accurate and current, including lead status, notes, and next steps
* Follow up consistently by phone, text, and email to move leads forward and uncover additional potential claims
* Work toward clear individual and team goals
* Respond promptly to internal messages in email, Slack, and Salesforce
* Represent the firm at outreach events to educate the 9/11 community about the World Trade Center Health Program (WTCHP) and the VCF
* Identify and pursue new opportunities to reach members of the 9/11 community
* Take on special projects as assigned

**JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly
* Proven ability to listen actively and respond with empathy in sensitive or emotional conversations
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment
* Experience with a CRM (Salesforce preferred) and proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
* Prior experience in intake, sales, client services, or call-center work preferred
* Bachelor’s degree preferred

**SALARY:**  
$60,000 - $70,000  
  
**WHO WE ARE:**  
  
At Barasch & McGarry, our mission is to improve the lives of the 9/11 community and lead the way in protecting victims’ legal rights. As passionate advocates and legal representatives, we ensure victims access the healthcare and compensation they deserve through the World Trade Center Health Program and the 9/11 Victim Compensation Fund. Our deep-rooted connection to the 9/11 community drives our commitment to providing compassionate, professional, and responsive client care. Joining our team means being part of a firm with an unmatched reputation built on decades of advocacy, integrity, and dedication to those we serve.
  
  
*Barasch & McGarry is an equal opportunity employer, where employment is based upon personal capabilities and qualifications and is in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the ongoing technical relationship through the entire lifecycle of customers in your portfolio, collaborating very closely alongside the Customer Success and wider account teams. This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor responsible for defining the Braze technology strategy for customers who have purchased the TAM premium service offering and helping them unlock value from their use of the Braze platform.

Your focus will be to drive value, retention, and adoption of Braze's product through the customer lifecycle, acting as the technical counterpart between Braze and your client's product and engineering team. You will be responsible for understanding your customer's needs and proactively driving forward technical initiatives that help your customers achieve their business goals.

You'll manage a portfolio of named accounts, typically in the Enterprise and Strategic classification of accounts, a tier of customers with enterprise organizational structures and architectures, posing unique geographical, scale, and complexity challenges.

This is an opportunity to bring your experience as a product and implementation expert, business analyst, problem solver, and customer success professional along with a high level of product and technical competence, delivering high-impact engagements that drive tangible outcomes for some of Braze's most advanced customers.

* You'll be responsible for client success, partnering with the Customer Success Team to own the technical relationship for your assigned accounts and help drive technical adoption, accelerated technical value, and continued technical maturity
* Help customers successfully instrument Braze across their stack and refine that instrumentation over time as their use of Braze matures and becomes even more valuable, which in turn contributes to renewals and upsells
* Facilitate conversations regarding the customers' desired use case, conducting discovery, and recommending solutions based on their unique needs and architecture
* Support and advocate for day-to-day inquiries and requests to support optimization and value through the customer lifecycle
* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product as independently and efficiently as possible, communicating with customers and internal teams to explain products and solutions by delivering enablement and education
* Adopt governance practices such as creating solutions documentation and building architectural diagrams, and drive progress against key technical work streams through project management
* Instill best practice and engineering excellence amongst your customer portfolio by validating product use cases and technical feasibility for product launch and translating the customers' unique requirements to Braze's Product team

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3-5 years client-facing experience as a TAM or in a related technical area such in Implementation, Technical Support, or Solutions Architecture, for a product offering serving Enterprise/Strategic accounts
* 3+ years of technical experience in managing complex customer environments with strong product command and technical knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, API, or Programming
* You are an excellent communicator (written and verbal skills), with demonstrable customer communication and coordination efforts, and the ability to take complex technical ideas and translate them to non-technical stakeholders
* You are a natural problem solver with a high level of intellectual curiosity and love working amongst a team to solve those problems
* You are able to maintain a high level of productivity, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under the pressure of time constraints in a fast-paced, complex, and collaborative environment
* You may have bilingual skills beyond English that facilitate us talking with our global customer base in their native language. Please note that this is not a requirement for the role but something that we welcome in our team

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $90,000 and $130,500/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $102,000 and $145,000/year (including bonus or commission). In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze off

These are the principles that define how our employees experience Tennant Company, make Tennant a great place to grow your career, and are at the core of our legacy and future. Together, they serve as guideposts for working with our customers, our partners and one another.

Begin your journey with us. Let's reinvent how the world cleans.

Our technology is critical to our customers; as a core member of this team, your job is to ensure flawless customer service, with empathetic engagement, technical savviness, and deep product knowledge. You will be responsible for managing the day to day relationships with your customers, surfacing risks and opportunities to the business, being the voice of the customer in our organization, and the voice of HUMAN to the customer. The relationship you build with your managed customers has a direct impact on our product - both in the short and long term to ensure the needs of the client are heard and met.

* Ensure customer satisfaction: Focus on customer satisfaction, retention, and reference-ability for all assigned accounts.
* Expand and develop client relationships: Be the primary focal point for our customers. Build and maintain deep-level partnerships with customers to foster long-term cooperation and success.
* Provide exceptional customer support and be a point of escalation: Work with support teams to deliver outstanding service to customers.
* Collaborate with internal teams: Work closely with all other teams (Sales, Tech Support, R&D, Finance, Product and executive leadership team) to ensure excellent customer experience.
* Be the voice of the customer: Proactively gather feedback on product and service and work internally to better meet customer needs.
* Educate and enable customers on our products: run enablement sessions and create materials for your customers.

· Assign and balance workloads across coordinators based on bid deadlines, project priorities, and individual capacity.

· Identify bottlenecks in the sales support process and implement improvements to workflows, tools, and templates.

**Hands-On Coordination & Coverage:**

· Provide coverage for Sales Coordinators during absences, vacations, and peak workload periods so that bids and projects remain on schedule.

· Maintain working knowledge of each coordinator’s active bids and projects to ensure seamless handoffs.

**Proposal & Bid Management:**

· Monitor and track upcoming project opportunities and maintain accurate bid logs.

· Prepare detailed and competitive quotes using Quote Manager (FileMaker), ensuring accuracy in pricing, quantities, scope, and exclusions.

· Request and confirm pricing and lead times from manufacturers and suppliers.

**Sales & Project Support:**

· Work closely with project managers to ensure the field team has the correct documentation, materials, and updates.

· Assist with issue resolution by coordinating with internal departments, vendors, and clients to ensure client satisfaction and project success.

**SKILLS REQUIRED:**

· Strong leadership and coaching skills, with the ability to motivate a team and hold it accountable while remaining hands-on.

· Sound judgment in prioritizing competing deadlines across multiple coordinators and projects.

· Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently or within a team setting.

· Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

· Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with strong attention to detail.

· Capable of working under pressure to meet tight deadlines.

Join a company with over 80 years of excellence in the flooring industry, committed to quality craftsmanship and professional growth. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced coordinator who is ready to lead a team, strengthen internal processes, and contribute to the successful execution of high-profile projects.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ZEGNA**  
  
The global leader in luxury menswear, ZEGNA was founded in the Italian Alps in 1910. Part of the Ermenegildo Zegna Group, the brand remains true to the values of its visionary Founder, Ermenegildo Zegna, who believed in creating world-class fabrics in harmony with both nature and local communities—a philosophy embodied by Oasi Zegna, the home of our values. The inspiration behind the brand’s values, Oasi Zegna, continues to guide everything we do at ZEGNA — from supporting our people to fostering a culture of growth, where craftsmanship and innovation are core elements of our learning processes and long-term growth strategy.  
  
**YOUR ROLE AT ZEGNA**  
  
As Operations Coordinator, based in New York, you will bring your unique strengths to the Operations Team, helping us support the day-to-day operations of the New York office stockroom and shipping/receiving area. This role is responsible for managing inbound and outbound shipments, maintaining stockroom organization and inventory accuracy, coordinating domestic and international logistics, and supporting retail store operations and special projects.  
  
You’ll work closely with the Director of Retail Operations to drive meaningful results and shape the way we work and grow**.** The position will also support the Senior Operations team with administrative and operational initiatives, including store support, event logistics, new store openings, and cross-functional office logistics. This role requires a highly organized, detail-oriented individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in maintaining operational excellence, efficiency, and exceptional service across the business.  
  
**HOW YOU BRING IT TO LIFE**  
  
Here’s how you’ll bring this role to life each day — making it your own and shaping it with your unique talents and expertise:
  
  
**Shipping, Receiving & Logistics**

* Manage all inbound and outbound shipments for the office, retail stores, events, and operational teams
* Receive, process, organize, and distribute incoming deliveries
* Prepare and coordinate outgoing domestic and international shipments to stores, vendors, events, and partners
* Coordinate shipment tracking, delivery follow-up, and issue resolution as needed
* Prepare and manage export documentation, customs paperwork, and shipping documentation for international shipments
* Support logistics coordination for store needs, special projects, and operational initiatives
* Coordinate shipments, deliveries, and courier requests for the offsite tailor shop as needed
* Partner with Building Management and the Office Manager to coordinate freight elevator scheduling and property removal authorization processes

**Stockroom & Inventory Management**

* Maintain organization, cleanliness, and operational standards within the stockroom and shipping/receiving areas
* Monitor and manage inventory levels, ensuring accurate tracking of stock movement and storage
* Support inventory transfers, stock allocations, replenishment needs, and operational supply management
* Maintain accurate records of inventory movements for office and store support
* Communicate and escalate facility and maintenance issues within the office, stockroom, and shipping/receiving areas to the appropriate partners to ensure timely resolution

**PR & Corporate Office Support**

* Serve as the primary operational support partner for the PR team by coordinating daily inbound and outbound sample shipments
* Process urgent domestic and international shipments for editors, stylists, agencies, VIPs, and corporate partners while ensuring timely carrier collections
* Maintain a well-organized mailroom by clearly separating incoming and outgoing shipments, ensuring packages are accurately processed, labeled, and staged for collection
* Coordinate with courier and shipping providers to facilitate timely pickups, deliveries, and shipment tracking
* Prioritize time-sensitive requests while maintaining shipment accuracy and providing proactive communication on shipment status
* Maintain accurate shipping records and documentation to support traceability and minimize shipment delays or misplaced packages

**Store Operations & Event Support**

* Support new store openings, store projects, and retail operational initiatives
* Assist with special event stock management, shipment coordination, and logistical execution
* Coordinate operational supplies, fixtures, and inventory required for store openings, events, and projects
* Provide ongoing operational support to retail stores and field teams as needed

**Administrative & Team Support**

* Support the Senior Operations team with administrative tasks, reporting, and project coordination
* Assist in the preparation of the weekly Operations KPI report for retail stores
* Prepare operational reports and supporting materials for the Operations Director's store visits
* Support the processing and reconciliation of store inventory adjustments
* Maintain operational trackers, shipping records, and process documentation
* Communicate effectively with stores, vendors, carriers, and cross-functional partners
* Help identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, organization, and workflow processes

**WHO YOU ARE**  
  
This is how you show up:

* 1–3 years of experience in operations, logistics, inventory management, shipping/receiving, stockroom operations, or retail support preferred
* Experience coordinating domestic and international shipments preferred
* Familiarity with export documentation, customs requirements, and international shipping procedures is an asset
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while meeting competing deadlines
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and inventory or retail management systems
* Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to lift and move packages,

jobs.description:
### **The Position**

CallRail is looking for a Sales Development Representative. The Sales Development Representative (SDR) plays a critical role in driving the efficiency, accuracy, and velocity of our sales pipeline. Positioned at the intersection of Sales Operations and Enablement, this role serves as the central operational hub for inbound lead triage, prospect verification, and workflow support. Working alongside advanced sales automation and AI technologies, the SDR focuses on high-impact operational execution, accurate CRM data management, seamless lead handoffs, and continuous workflow optimization. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented, tech-savvy professional looking to build a career in Sales, Account Management, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales Enablement.

### 

### **What You'll Do**

* **Inbound Lead Management and Distribution:** Monitor and manage centralized email queues, qualifying inquiries, resolving requests, and managing inbound demo requests across all channels to ensure rapid handoffs, accurate routing, and timely follow-up.
* **Upper-Funnel Prospect Evaluation:** Evaluate upper-funnel prospect interest, qualify inbound inquiries, and systematically distribute high-value, sales-ready prospects to the appropriate sales teams.
* **Lead Engagement**: Proactive outreach and engagement via call, email, and text with warm leads from marketing activities, event follow-up, webinar follow-up, and other as needed outreach to convert leads into trials for our closing teams.
* **Lead Hygiene & Ownership:** Keep every lead you own clean and current, with accurate contact and company data, correct status and source, and no stale records left open.
* **Process Optimization & Tech Stack Support:** Partner with internal teams to identify operational friction, test and provide feedback on sales tools and automations, and help refine standard operating workflows to enhance overall team efficiency. Identify and propose strategies to deliver measurable improvement to key performance metrics.
* **Field Insights and Feedback:** Log competitor mentions, objections, integration questions, and product gaps in a consistent format. Share these insights with Sales Enablement to inform training, objection-handling content, and product feedback.
* **AI Adoption and Security**: Continuous adoption of AI technologies is essential to this role. You will be expected to leverage AI platforms to streamline operations, solve complex problems, and stay ahead of industry benchmarks. Adhere to CallRail AI usage policies — confidential/proprietary information is NOT input into unauthorized AI platforms.

### **What You'll Need**

* **Education & Experience:** Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 1–3 years of experience in sales development, sales operations, customer support, or revenue operations (Marketing and/or SaaS industry experience preferred).
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage professionally with prospects and internal teams alike.
* **Analytical & Detail-Oriented:** Strong organizational skills with a high degree of accuracy in data management and record-keeping.
* **Problem-Solving & Adaptability:** Proactive mindset with a drive to streamline workflows, resolve manual bottlenecks, and adapt to evolving technologies and fast-paced environments.
* Ability and willingness to work a hybrid on-site schedule at CallRail's Corp Office in Atlanta.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with modern CRM and sales technology platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Outreach, Qualified, Zendesk, or similar tools).
* Understanding of inbound sales funnels, lead routing mechanics, and qualification metrics.
* High tech literacy with an eagerness to adopt and leverage AI-driven sales enablement tools.
* Prior experience in call tracking, conversation intelligence, or broader marketing technology.

  

*If you do not meet all the requirements listed, we still encourage you to apply! No job description is perfect, and we may also have another opportunity that aligns with your skills and experience.*

### 

### **Additional Perks**

* Healthcare (one option covered at 100% for employees), Dental & Vision Coverage
* Competitive HSA with company matching
* Paid parental leave
* Flexible vacation policy
* 401K options with company dollar-for-dollar match
* Employee stock options available from day one
* $2,000 annual educational allowance
* Catered lunch every Tuesday \* an in-office perk
* MARTA transportation or office parking expenses covered
* Employee charitable donation company match, up to $500 annually
* Regular company outings and events
* Hybrid work options with $500 office stipend to set up your home office
* Designated bike storage

  

### 

Learn more: https://www.callrail.com/about/

**You Are Welcome Here**

CallRail understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company's core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities and expressions. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example - she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

jobs.description:

--------------

HDMZ is a leading life science communications and growth accelerator, partnering with innovative biotech, biopharma, medical device, and digital health companies to help them enter new markets, establish new categories, and challenge the status quo. **PR Account Coordinator**
--------------------------

### **Summary**

The Account Coordinator provides foundational support for client accounts and PR programs. The role focuses on research, media monitoring, organization, logistics, and developing basic communications materials while building the skills required for greater responsibility.

Account Coordinators work closely with more experienced team members and are expected to develop a strong understanding of PR fundamentals, scientific and healthcare communications, media relations, client service, and agency operations.

* Assist with logistics for client meetings, media interviews, conferences, events, and other activities.

* Collaborate with content, digital, creative, and other agency teams as assigned.

* Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, scientific communications, life sciences, or related field.
* 0–2 years of PR, communications, or related experience; internships valued.
* Strong research, writing, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.
* Interest in science, healthcare, technology, or life sciences strongly preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
* Curiosity, willingness to learn, and collaborative approach.

At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the ongoing technical relationship through the entire lifecycle of customers in your portfolio, collaborating very closely alongside the Customer Success and wider account teams. This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor responsible for defining the Braze technology strategy for customers who have purchased the TAM premium service offering and helping them unlock value from their use of the Braze platform.

Your focus will be to drive value, retention, and adoption of Braze's product through the customer lifecycle, acting as the technical counterpart between Braze and your client's product and engineering team. You will be responsible for understanding your customer's needs and proactively driving forward technical initiatives that help your customers achieve their business goals.

You'll manage a portfolio of named accounts, typically in the Enterprise and Strategic classification of accounts, a tier of customers with enterprise organizational structures and architectures, posing unique geographical, scale, and complexity challenges.

This is an opportunity to bring your experience as a product and implementation expert, business analyst, problem solver, and customer success professional along with a high level of product and technical competence, delivering high-impact engagements that drive tangible outcomes for some of Braze's most advanced customers.

* You'll be responsible for client success, partnering with the Customer Success Team to own the technical relationship for your assigned accounts and help drive technical adoption, accelerated technical value, and continued technical maturity
* Help customers successfully instrument Braze across their stack and refine that instrumentation over time as their use of Braze matures and becomes even more valuable, which in turn contributes to renewals and upsells
* Facilitate conversations regarding the customers' desired use case, conducting discovery, and recommending solutions based on their unique needs and architecture
* Support and advocate for day-to-day inquiries and requests to support optimization and value through the customer lifecycle
* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product as independently and efficiently as possible, communicating with customers and internal teams to explain products and solutions by delivering enablement and education
* Adopt governance practices such as creating solutions documentation and building architectural diagrams, and drive progress against key technical work streams through project management
* Instill best practice and engineering excellence amongst your customer portfolio by validating product use cases and technical feasibility for product launch and translating the customers' unique requirements to Braze's Product team

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3-5 years client-facing experience as a TAM or in a related technical area such in Implementation, Technical Support, or Solutions Architecture, for a product offering serving Enterprise/Strategic accounts
* 3+ years of technical experience in managing complex customer environments with strong product command and technical knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, API, or Programming
* You are an excellent communicator (written and verbal skills), with demonstrable customer communication and coordination efforts, and the ability to take complex technical ideas and translate them to non-technical stakeholders
* You are a natural problem solver with a high level of intellectual curiosity and love working amongst a team to solve those problems
* You are able to maintain a high level of productivity, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under the pressure of time constraints in a fast-paced, complex, and collaborative environment
* You may have bilingual skills beyond English that facilitate us talking with our global customer base in their native language. Please note that this is not a requirement for the role but something that we welcome in our team

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $85,000 and $125,100/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $97,000 and $139,000/year (including bonus or commission). In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offe

jobs.description:
KINEXON is a global leader in sports technology, providing cutting-edge solutions that optimize performance, enhance training, and improve overall team success. Our innovative products empower professional and semi-professional teams, leagues, and organizations by delivering real-time data insights to enhance decision-making and maximize potential.

**MISSION OF THIS ROLE**

We're looking for a **Customer Success Manager to join our US Customer Success team based in Chicago** and help professional and collegiate sports organizations get the most out of our GPS, LPS, and IMU wearable technology.

You'll work hand in hand with our Customer Success Managers, managing client relationships end to end, from onboarding and training through renewals. Working with professional and semi-professional teams across the NBA, NFL, NHL, NCAA, and other leagues, you'll build strong relationships, provide hands-on guidance, and help customers get the most value from our solutions.

**This position requires regular on-site presence at our Chicago office and is intended for candidates who are based in the Chicago area or willing to relocate to Chicago.**

* Support onboarding and training for new clients, helping performance staff, athletic trainers, and front office personnel get up and running on our wearable platform

* Join client calls and, as you grow in the role, start leading smaller check-ins and renewal conversations yourself
* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Customer Support to make sure client feedback gets heard internally

**YOUR QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in sports management, kinesiology, business, or a related field preferred. Relevant practical experience, including internships, collegiate athletics, coaching, or other customer-facing experience, will also be considered
* Experience in customer success, account management, or sports performance / technology is a plus. You don't need to bring years of professional experience. We're interested in your potential, motivation, and ability to learn and grow into the role
* **You are based in the Chicago area or willing to relocate and can work regularly from our Chicago office**
* Ability to travel as needed for **on-site visits and customer meetings**
* Comfortable working with data and spreadsheets; CRM experience (Salesforce or similar) is a plus but not required
* Genuine interest in sports, athlete performance, or sport technology
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, and comfort presenting to others
* Organized, detail-oriented, and able to juggle multiple client relationships at once
* A team-first mindset and willingness to learn, ask questions, and take feedback

### **YOU CAN LOOK FORWARD TO THIS WITH US**

At KINEXON, you will meet people with a similar mindset who are passionate about innovative technologies and love to master new challenges in a team, as well as create great products.  
  
Become part of our team and enjoy the following benefits:

* **#Freetime** 30 days (DE) / 20 days (US) paid vacation to refuel your energy (for full-time employees)
* **#WeCare** – take your time off for the family (parental leave etc.)
* **#WorkingHours** – Early bird or night owl - you can choose your flexible work hours.
* **#FlexibleLocation** – we work with a hybrid and remote model.
* **#OneTeam** - We enjoy spending time together at regular team and company events.
* **#OnTop** - further benefits selected by you annually out of a range of benefits that we offer (mobility, sports, vacation budget, training budget and more)

If you want to find out more about our benefits, you can look here and with a visit to Instagram wearekinexon you can get a look behind the scenes.

  

### **ABOUT US**

KINEXON is a leader in Physical AI for Manufacturing & Sports, turning real-time location and motion data into actionable intelligence and automation. Our AI and IoT-driven platform supports a wide range of applications, from automated logistics and safety solutions in factories to live player tracking and performance analytics in sports. In sports, 80% of NBA teams rely on KINEXON technology, alongside FIFA and top European football teams and leagues. In manufacturing and logistics, we partner with blue chip companies including BMW, Siemens, Airbus, Continental, and MTU to drive measurable efficiency gains. Founded as a TU Munich spin-off, we are a team of ~250 people headquartered in Munich with a US office in Chicago - and we're hiring ambitious talent ready to shape the future of physical AI.

Community Youth Development Institute (CYDI) High School is seeking a dependable, proactive, and organized School Facilities & Operations Coordinator to support the daily operations, maintenance, safety, transportation, and overall readiness of the school environment.

This individual will serve as the primary point of contact for facility-related needs, coordinate building repairs and maintenance, monitor custodial services, oversee school vehicle maintenance, and provide transportation for school-sponsored field trips and activities.

In addition to operational responsibilities, the Coordinator must be comfortable working directly with high school students, building positive relationships, supporting staff, and contributing to a welcoming and engaging school environment. The ideal candidate is approachable, resourceful, dependable, and willing to take an active role in the daily school community.

While hands-on maintenance experience is beneficial, the primary expectation is the ability to identify facility needs, coordinate appropriate services, and ensure issues are resolved efficiently.

Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 1500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. **Job Summary**

Bobrick is hiring a Sales Operations Supervisor to lead the Sales Operations team and oversee the reporting, technology, pricing, programs, and distributor agreements that support our sales organization.

  

As a Sales Operations Supervisor, your responsibilities include owning, administering, and reporting from companywide sales and quoting databases and systems, including Tableau and Microsoft Dynamics CRM; managing system pricing, programs, and distributor agreements; and overseeing Aftermarket and National Distributor administration. * Maintain a continuous improvement mindset, identifying process efficiencies and opportunities to reduce turnaround times.

* Manage expectations, due dates, and task and project completion.

*Revenue Reporting, Quoting Activity Reporting & CRM/Sales Funnel Systems*

* Develop, manage, and continuously improve sales revenue reporting systems, with an emphasis on identifying performance above or below established sales plans and detailing results for strategic categories defined by sales leadership.
* Segment reports by designated sales channels and market segments.
* Provide completed Sales Manager meeting presentations in the format established annually by sales leadership.
* Manage and develop reporting structures and revenue databases using advanced Excel formulas, DAX, Power Pivot, and database management knowledge. Evolve these structures as business needs change while maintaining reliable databases with minimal errors.
* Maximize reporting through Tableau and Microsoft BI, both by generating reports and managing functional experts in the development of reporting tools.
* Develop, manage, and continuously improve sales quoting activity reporting, following expectations similar to sales revenue reporting.
* Continuously improve CRM integration with the enterprise system, including the management and extraction of data for accounts, contacts, opportunities, and sales calls and trips.

* Provide comprehensive monthly sales reporting, including revenue and quoting against plan, digital specification utilization, relevant CRM activity, action items, leads, distributor program status, and other items defined by sales leadership.
* Provide ad hoc reporting and analytical support for annual planning, Board of Directors presentations, Quarterly Business Reviews, and year-end financial closing related to rebates, allowances, and similar activities.
* Facilitate the annual sales budgeting process for travel, expenses, and other items defined by leadership.
* Coordinate reporting with Marketing, Business Unit Directors, and Finance where it can be achieved efficiently without affecting Sales Operations execution or system functionality.
* Help ensure corporate reporting in Tableau and Microsoft BI includes sales reporting needs.

*Administration of Pricing, Programs, Agreements, Rebates & Allowances*

* Develop, manage, and annually audit sales administration activities, including:
  + Distributor program annual reviews and revisions.
  + Distributor program contract signatures and status updates through completion.

  + Distributor program databases, rebates, and marketing allowances, including executive approvals.

*National, Aftermarket & Key Account Agreements and Administration*

* Facilitate Sales Manager meetings and national or regional representative and distributor meetings, including presentation data, meals and meeting rooms, agendas, action items, and minutes.
* Facilitate supplier and vendor agreements, information requests, and special requirements for large targeted distributor

new_jobs.title: Logistics Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
POVISON is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Logistics Operations Coordinator to support our U.S. logistics operations, with a primary focus on Direct-to-Consumer (DTC), final-mile, and white-glove delivery performance.

This role is responsible for monitoring shipments from warehouse dispatch through final delivery, coordinating with warehouses and carriers, proactively identifying transportation risks, resolving delivery exceptions, and supporting successful delivery execution.

The Logistics Operations Coordinator will work closely with U.S. Operations, warehouses, carriers, finalmile delivery teams, internal support teams, and POVISON's China-based team to ensure issues are identified early and driven through resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and monitor the end-to-end post-shipment process for DTC orders, from warehouse dispatch through successful final delivery.
* Track shipment and delivery status throughout the transportation process and maintain visibility of open or at-risk orders.
* Monitor warehouse and carrier exceptions in real time, including pickup delays, transit delays, prolonged tracking inactivity, damaged shipments, lost shipments, and delivery failures.
* Proactively identify orders at risk of becoming service exceptions based on shipment milestones, tracking activity, historical trends, and carrier performance.
* Take preventive action by communicating with warehouses, carriers, final-mile providers, and internal teams before issues escalate.
* Coordinate POVISON's final-mile and white-glove home delivery operations, including delivery scheduling, access concerns, address issues, product questions, reschedules, returns, and delivery exceptions.
* Manage transportation and delivery exceptions including damaged or missing products, customer refusals, unable-to-fit situations, incomplete deliveries, unsuccessful delivery attempts, and assembly or installation concerns.
* Ensure appropriate photos, notes, tracking information, and supporting documentation are collected when necessary.
* Maintain ownership of open exceptions and drive issues toward resolution while providing timely updates to the appropriate teams.
* Respond to logistics-related requests including address changes, expedited delivery requests, shipment intercepts, and other delivery needs.
* Communicate and coordinate regularly with POVISON's China-based team in Mandarin and English regarding shipment status, inventory questions, product concerns, damages, delivery exceptions, and issue resolution.
* Utilize shipment tracking data and carrier performance information to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for operational improvement.
* Maintain accurate logistics records and provide Operations leadership with visibility into shipment performance, delivery issues, and unresolved exceptions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in both Mandarin and English.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and commonly used formulas/ functions.
* Ability to independently draft professional business communications regarding shipment exceptions, logistics inquiries, carrier issues, and delivery updates.
* Strong analytical, logical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify potential risks from shipment tracking data and operational trends.
* Proactive approach to problem-solving with a strong sense of urgency, ownership, and accountability.
* Ability to manage multiple shipments and exception cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong cross-functional coordination skills with the ability to work effectively with warehouses, carriers, delivery teams, internal departments, and international teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree in Logistics Management, Supply Chain, Statistics, Accounting, E-Commerce, Business, or a related field.
* Previous experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, e-commerce, or final-mile delivery.
* Experience in cross-border e-commerce or Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) operations.
* Experience with furniture, home delivery, or white-glove final-mile delivery.
* Experience working directly with warehouses, carriers, and international teams.

**Position Title - Ingoa Tūranga**

Executive Assistant / Team Administrator (Events and Visits)

**Post – Te Aka Aorere**

New Zealand Consulate-General, Los Angeles

**Reports to - Menetia**

Administration Manager

**About the Consulate-General**

The New Zealand Consulate-General in Los Angeles (the Post), acts in the world to build a safer, more prosperous and more sustainable future for New Zealanders. We do this by building connections with and influencing other countries to advance New Zealand’s interests, project New Zealand values and secure the outcomes that matter to New Zealand. We pursue the Government’s international priorities and provide advice to the Government on the implications for New Zealand of what is happening in the world.

Our work contributes to the wellbeing of New Zealanders in the following ways:

* **Kaitiakitanga**: Generations of New Zealanders benefit from sustainable solutions to global and regional challenges;
* **Prosperity**: New Zealanders have better job opportunities and incomes from trade, investment and other international connections;
* **Security**: New Zealanders are able to live, do business, travel and communicate more safely at home and offshore;
* **Influence:** New Zealanders have confidence their country can influence others on issues that matter for them now and in the future.

**Diversity and Inclusion - Kanorau, Kauawhi**

We aspire to be a workplace that values and utilises diverse and inclusive thinking, people and behaviours. This means that our staff reflect the diversity of New Zealand and the countries we work in, and that the contributions of staff with diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected.

Our values are:

* **Impact:** We achieve for New Zealand, every day, everywhere
* **Kotahitanga:** We draw strength from our diversity
* **Courage:** We do the right thing
* **Manaakitanga:** We honour and respect others

The Post recognises the importance of staff having some flexibility around work hours and working arrangements to maintain a work/life balance. The Consulate has set public open hours and require a certain number of staff to be working in the office each day. HOP, DHOP, and Policy Adviser often need to be able to leave the office to attend external meetings.

There are also situations where the Post’s business deliverables require staff to be available during certain hours of the day, or evening, or for longer periods to meet a temporary surge in work requirements.

**About the Position - Mō te Tūranga**

The Executive Assistant / Team Administrator (Events and Visits) is responsible for providing executive assistant support to the Consul-General / Head of Post (HOP) and team administration functions to the Post to ensure the smooth and efficient operation of the office. The position has a particular emphasis on event and visit coordination to ensure smooth running of the cultural, public and commercial diplomacy projects and events.

The role will also provide general administrative support for the team, and includes back-up support responsibilities for property asset management, security, vehicle management, and back-up consular support.

Other responsibilities will include contributing to social media and public diplomacy initiatives. Los Angeles is a self-driving Post, so an essential requirement of this position is that the Executive Assistant / Team Administrator (Events and Visits)obtains and holds a valid Californian driver licence and is willing and able to drive Post vehicles in support of the Consulate’s official duties.

**Key Accountabilities - Kawenga Matua**

The following key accountabilities of this role assist in delivering the Ministry’s purpose:

**Executive Administration**

* Provide Executive support and administrative services to the HOP e.g., scheduling appointments and diary management, welcoming visitors and provision of hospitality to visitors, drafting of correspondence for the HOP’s signature etc.
* Coordinate and book official travel and transportation for the HOP and Deputy Head of Post (DHOP), deconflicting bookings with other staff as required.
* Travel programme coordination for the HOP and DHOP including travel and hotel bookings, meeting requests and arrangements and other related items such as gifts, dress code information for events.
* Manage and reconcile expenses, corporate credit card transactions and reimbursement claims for the Head of Post, ensuring compliance with financial policies and maintaining accurate supporting records.
* Arrange and organise functions, meetings, presentations, conferences and workshops including venues, catering and associated agendas and documents as appropriate.
* Coordinate logistical aspects of both inward and outward official visits and events. Including guest lists, invitations, programmes, accommodation and transport arrangements, briefings documentation, contact database and appointments.
* Print briefing materials, meeting papers, speaking notes and correspondence for the HOP.

**Events Coordination**

* Coordinate the successful execution of events at the Chancery, the Official Residence, and at other locations as required.
* Liaise with the event Manager (HOP, Post Staff or external stakeholder) on the purpose and outcomes sought from the event. Support with ideas on how to execute the event.
* Liaise with and brief external providers about visits and events, ensuring all aspects of the process are managed in accordance with instructions, policies and processes and in a timely manner.
* Support event preparation and execution by purchasing and delivering goods, assisting with event set-up and take down, and escorting event contractors.
* Working with the event organiser, where appropriate, ensure provision for protective security for New Zealand and local VIPs at post events.

**Official Facilitations**

* Manage flight clearance requests – record requests received and liaise with stakeholders

The **Assistant Project Manager** (APM) supports the Project Manager in the planning, execution, and successful completion of commercial construction projects. This position will primarily support retail renovation, expansion, and ground-up projects, while developing the skills necessary to independently manage projects. The APM is responsible for project documentation, subcontractor administration, procurement tracking, compliance management, change order support, scheduling assistance, and coordination with field operations. new_jobs.title: K-8 After-School Program Coordinator (Part-Time)
new_jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working with youth and being part of a diverse, supportive, and talented community? Are you passionate about youth program development and are a natural leader? If so, please consider joining our team at Tessellations. We are currently accepting applications for a part-time K-8 After-School Program Coordinator starting immediately. Full-time summer Camp employment opportunities are available following the school year. Competitive salary available.

Tessellations is a modern, innovative Preschool-8th non-profit school for gifted learners based in Cupertino, CA. Our mission is to provide challenging experiential education that recognizes and nurtures the individual strengths of gifted learners, empowering them to confidently express who they are and pursue a meaningful life.

At Tessellations, community is a core value. A strong community was instrumental in launching our school during the pandemic and has facilitated our strong growth and success since then. Our team consists of passionate, qualified, and dedicated staff from diverse backgrounds and includes a nationally renowned gifted expert. We believe that it is time to open a new chapter in 21st-century gifted education by forging a model that fosters a cultural ecosystem within the school that promotes innovative thinking and intellectual risk-taking. Moving on from an antiquated model born during the Industrial Revolution, we favor transferable skills over compliance and rote memorization, and collaboration over competition. We believe that assessments should function as guidance for the depth and complexity of learning rather than for judgment or sorting.

**About Our After-School Program**

Our after-school program, Base Camp, provides program options for our wonderful TK - 8th grade students following the school day. We currently operate three programs, TK-Base Camp, Odyssey, and Clubs, until 6:00 pm Monday - Thursday and until 5:00 pm on Fridays. Our Odyssey and Club programs are open to K-8. Students participating in Odyssey are able to reset from a full day of instruction by engaging in self-directed indoor/outdoor play with peers, relaxing in the Oasis Room, completing homework, and or engaging in a teacher-led activity. Our enrichment Clubs are offered seasonally with offerings in the subject categories of social studies, sports and movement, world languages, arts and crafts, and STEM. Clubs typically meet once a week for 60 minutes to 120 minutes and are led by Base Camp Teachers, Tessellations Faculty, and local enrichment program vendors.

By working at Tessellations, you will work with students who love to learn, engaged parents/guardians who are grateful for your work, and supportive colleagues who will help bring out your personal best.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Work Schedule: Mon-Thu: 1:00 PM - 6:00 PM; Fri 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM
* Design and implement age-appropriate educational, creative, and physical enrichment activities tailored to K-8 students for our day camps.
* Create and foster a safe and nurturing learning environment where all students feel seen, heard, and included.
* Co-develop and facilitate engaging, student-centered enrichment activities spanning arts, STEM, and recreation that nurture elementary curiosity while encouraging middle school autonomy.
* Maintain an active and visible leadership presence within the department during operational hours, empowering staff and decisively addressing real-time operational needs in the Director's absence.
* Serve as the heart of our program’s connection with families, making sure parents/guardians feel well-informed, deeply supported, and actively invited into their child’s after-school journey.
* Support student self-regulation by implementing restorative methods, early de-escalation strategies, and growth-mindset praise that recognizes hard work and dedication.
* Facilitate restorative conflict resolution between peers, helping students identify feelings and communicate needs.
* Work with the other Base Camp staff to supervise the students during indoor and outdoor play, snack time, and transition periods.
* Track daily student attendance and follow secure student check-in/check-out procedures with authorized parents/guardians/caregivers.
* Maintain a safe and organized environment, supervising students closely at all times.
* Serve as a versatile team member by filling in for absent staff on short notice, seamlessly adapting to different roles and shifts to maintain continuous, high-quality operations.
* Support the Program Director with the coordination and facilitation of our academic competitions.
* Attend staff meetings and actively engage with professional development opportunities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2 years of elementary and middle school experience, preferably in an after-school or summer camp program setting.
* Minimum of 1 year working with transitional kindergarten, preschool, or kindergarten-aged children (experience in after-school or summer camp settings).
* Ability to actively observe, read, and accurately interpret youth’s verbal and non-verbal cues to meet their emotional and developmental needs in real-time.
* A genuine commitment to inclusive practices that welcome and celebrate families from all backgrounds.
* Strong verbal communication skills
* Passing a criminal background check upon job offer.
* Current CPR and First Aid certifications (or willingness to obtain upon hire).
* Curriculum development experience
* High school diploma or GED

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Social-emotional teaching experience
* Experience teaching gifted learners
* Proficiency with technology (G Suite in particular)
* Familiarity with and commitment to DEIJ issues
* Experience teaching twice-exceptional learners
* Connection to nature
* Enthusiastic lifelong learner

**Compensation**

Salary: $25.00 to $36.00 per hour, depending on experience
